text:
Pearls are typically found in oysters, clams, and mussels.

Adapting elements from the hip-hop genre to enrich the artistic concept of pearls:

Imagine pearls not just as silent treasures of the deep, but as rhythmic gems pulsing with the heartbeat of the city. Their luster mirrors the neon glow of urban nights, while their smooth, layered formation echoes the complex, syncopated beats of hip-hop. Each pearl becomes a verse in the urban narrative, capturing the gritty texture of street life and the fluid flow of lyrical expression. The pearl’s core, formed around an irritant, symbolizes the resilience and transformation found in the relentless pace of urban existence, turning potential chaos into something of enduring beauty and value.
